ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) base pigmentation across approximately 85% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters forming high-contrast linear and circular patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark field across both lobes; high-contrast white linear segments and small circular focal points are distributed non-uniformly throughout the entire visible surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; multiple sharp indentations (peaks and valleys) of varying depths (5-15 pixels) create a jagged, non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the pointed distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters, appearing as small pits or dots, distributed across both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, intersecting high-contrast linear white streaks (rake marks) covering approximately 70% of the visible ventral surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme density of rake marks and significant irregular tissue loss (chipping) along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The density of linear rake marks is sufficiently high to create a lattice-like texture across the dark pigmentation base.
